comment: Reader assigned at the subscription's own scope, as returned by GET /subscriptions/{id}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/permissions?api-version=2022-04-01. The built-in Reader role carries actions ['*/read'] with no notActions, so the wildcard covers Microsoft.Resources/subscriptions/resources/read and scope_verified is true (Req 12.2). This is the only recorded permissions fixture that may produce true.
